question: In berkshire_13f_q4_2024_holdings.csv, a single issuer may appear on several rows. Aggregate valueUSD by nameOfIssuer, then compute the combined value of the three largest issuers as a percentage of the total valueUSD of all rows. Round to 2 decimals.
solve_py:
import os, pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
a=pd.read_csv(D+'/berkshire_13f_q4_2024_holdings.csv');g=a.groupby('nameOfIssuer').valueUSD.sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(round(g.head(3).sum()/a.valueUSD.sum()*100,2))
